We gamified Quran memorization with burgers and milkshakes.

Here's why 100+ huffadh are loving it:

Walking through East London Mosque, you see them everywhere.

Brothers in corners perfecting every ayah of the Quran.

Some staying up late, others coming at Fajr.

Many of us struggle to just finish reading the Quran during Ramadan.

But these huffadh (memorizers) perfect it completely - verse by verse, chapter by chapter.

And they do this every single year.

Most don't realize the sacrifice:
• Months away from family
• Time off work
• Countless hours of revision
• Mental strain of perfection

That's why we launched our "Road to Ramadan" campaign at Simply Smashed.

We've gamified their Quran revision journey:
• 5 chapters = Punch on our machine
• 10 chapters = Milkshake
• 15 chapters = Tiramisu
• 20 chapters = Wings
• 25 chapters = Loaded fries
• Complete Quran = Everything + burger

We're partnering with Europe's largest gathering of huffadh - where hundreds come to revise.

When we started Simply Smashed, people said "just focus on the burgers."

But it was never just about the food.

We're about recognizing the people in our community who don't get enough recognition.

The ones who sacrifice silently.

The ones who serve others without praise.

That's what barakah-based building means to us.

Not maximizing profits.

Maximizing impact.

Sometimes that means Sisters' Nights.

Sometimes Fajr Knights.

And sometimes it means supporting those who preserve the words of Allah.

It might not be much, but it's our way of saying: We see your dedication. We appreciate your sacrifice.

↓

This Ramadan, let's show our huffadh they're valued.

Drop by Simply Smashed to support their journey and maybe catch them taking a well-deserved break between revisions.
